The Gumroad API *documents* POST /v2/products with published=false / draft=true (returns an unpublished product) plus PUT /:id/disable and DELETE /:id -- so the platform supports drafts and reversibility. But our integration's create_product() omits the field, a real live creation defaulted to published:true with a public page (channels/gumroad_arm.py:8-13), the docs are internally inconsistent about the default, and creation is non-idempotent. Until a live draft is verified, this remains an unverified capability and automated creation stays blocked.
